data.name: Wasl Mobility Modaraba
data.description: Wasl Mobility Modaraba (Formerly First Prudential Modaraba) is a multipurpose, perpetual Modaraba. The Modaraba is registered under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980. The Modaraba is engaged in various modes of Islamic funding's and businesses which include ijarah financing, deployment of fund in musharika, morabaha and investment in securities.
